data.acceptance: A deferral recorded via the ledger tooling always carries owner, reason, unblock condition, priority, source reference, and review trigger; deferred knots are surfaced automatically at session start; router notes containing deferral prose without a knot reference produce a visible warning; the four known prose-only deferrals are retro-filled as knots; new unit tests cover record validation, digest output, and note checking; no protected engine files are modified.
